s.note: Gertrude Lightstone's Christmas Eve at the mansion
s.how: Warm 16 cocktail blinis on a tray at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Flake 150g hot-smoked salmon. Top each blini with a spoon of crème fraîche, a few flakes of salmon and 1/2 tsp salmon roe from a 50g jar. Finish with snipped chives and cracked pepper and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: Santa working through cookie plates house to house
s.how: Melt 250g butter and cook until golden brown and nutty, then chill until firm but soft. Beat with 110g caster sugar, then mix in 300g plain flour, 60g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick with a fork and bake at 160C for 35 minutes. Cut into 20 fingers while warm and cool. Dip one end in 150g melted dark chocolate and sprinkle with crushed candy cane and sea salt.

m.how: Rub a 2kg beef rib roast with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, oil and salt. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes for medium rare. Rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1.2kg potatoes, rough up, toss in 3 tbsp duck fat and roast 50 minutes. Simmer the pan juices with 200ml red wine and 300ml beef stock until reduced by half. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream and lemon.

w.how: Drain a 680g jar pitted cherries, keeping the syrup. Break a 400g chocolate cake into a glass bowl and drizzle with 100ml of the syrup. Scatter over the cherries. Whisk 2 tbsp cocoa into 600ml thick vanilla custard and pour over. Chill 1 hour. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, spread on top, then shave 50g dark chocolate over with a peeler.

d.note: Santa drinking at the pub before his shift
d.how: Chill 4 pint glasses. Pour 440ml cold stout into each glass at an angle, then straighten up to build a creamy head and let it settle for a minute before topping up. Pour 30ml whisky into 4 shot glasses and serve alongside. For non-drinkers, fill glasses with ice, add a squeeze of lime and 2 dashes of bitters and top with cola.
